name: QR Code Generator & Tracker by QRTracker
description: Create QR codes for any Firefox page. Download PNG/SVG free, or save tracked QR codes to QRTracker for scan analytics.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://qrtracker.io; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline';
